articles.headline: 'It breaks my heart': Emotional Hellberg hits out at 'disgraceful spying'
articles.description: Kim Hellberg said the 'Spygate' saga that overshadowed his Middlesbrough side's Championship play-off semi-final defeat to Southampton was "disgraceful" and "breaks my heart".

articles.headline: Moreno: VAR's tone was too dismissive of other fouls in Arsenal game
articles.description: As VAR Audio of the disallowed West Ham goal vs. Arsenal is released, Alejandro Moreno says the VAR official was "leading the witness" in the way they spoke to the referee.

articles.headline: Tottenham's James Maddison: Officials 'petrified' to make decisions
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur midfielder James Maddison has said officials are "petrified" to make decisions after being denied a stoppage-time penalty against Leeds.

articles.headline: Pep: I have never trusted anything with VAR
articles.description: Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola says he has "never trusted anything" with referees and VAR after a pivotal decision in the Premier League title race.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United looking at five summer signings
articles.description: Manchester United are looking at a big summer to sign several new players in key positions. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Saints edge Boro late in extra-time to reach play-off final amid 'Spygate' drama
articles.description: Southampton beat Middlesbrough 2-1 at St Mary's to book their place in the Sky Bet Championship play-off final for the second time in three seasons.

articles.headline: Andrey Santos: Representing Brazil at the World Cup will be the best moment of my career
articles.description: After being named in Brazil's 55-man World Cup shortlist, Andrey Santos tells ESPN "it is a pleasure playing in the national team."

articles.headline: Andrey Santos: We know we can do more next season
articles.description: Chelsea's Andrey Santos tells ESPN that "they have to work hard to win trophies", saying "they know they can do more" in the Premier League.

articles.headline: Refs boss Howard Webb: Arsenal, West Ham VAR call "categorically" correct
articles.description: Referees' chief Howard Webb said the decision to disallow what would have been a crucial West Ham United equaliser against Arsenal last Sunday was "categorically" correct and called it "a good use of VAR.

articles.headline: Manchester City vs. Crystal Palace in Premier League: TV channel, kick-off time, live stream, referee, injury and team news
articles.description: All you need to know ahead of the Premier League clash between Manchester City and Crystal Palace,

articles.headline: Arsenal's Ben White out for rest of season with knee injury, set to miss World Cup
articles.description: Arsenal have confirmed that defender Ben White will miss the remainder of the season due to a knee injury.

articles.headline: Pep Guardiola: Rodri and Abdukodir Khusanov will be fit to face Chelsea in FA Cup final
articles.description: Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola has revealed that Rodri and Abdukodir Khusanov will be available for selection to face Chelsea in the FA Cup final.

articles.headline: What Tottenham and West Ham need to happen to ensure their own Premier League survival
Why Man United should think twice about hiring Carrick as permanent coach
articles.description: Everyone seems to agree Michael Carrick should be Man United's next permanent manager -- but they aren't looking at what matters.

articles.headline: Senegal winger Ismaila Sarr's skill has caught up to his speed at Crystal Palace's finishing school
articles.description: Crystal Palace is a club that has a fine track record for developing wide players to go onto bigger and better things, and Senegal's Ismaila Sarr, who now has 20 goals this season, is the latest proof of that.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso, Andoni Iraola in frame for Chelsea job, but no preferred candidate - sources
articles.description: Alonso and Iraola are two prominent names on Chelsea's manager shortlist, but there is no firm front runner at this stage, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Haunted Tottenham return West Ham's favour as relegation battle takes fresh twist
articles.description: After West Ham missed the chance to move four points clear of Tottenham in April, Roberto De Zerbi's haunted team returned the favour against Leeds.

articles.headline: Do West Ham still have a chance of staying up over Tottenham?
articles.description: The 'FC TV' crew react to Tottenham's 1-1 draw with Leeds United in the Premier League.

articles.headline: Tottenham 1-1 Leeds: Roberto De Zerbi's side blow another chance to move towards safety
articles.description: Tottenham fail to win at home again as they move two points clear of West Ham in an absorbing relegation battle, rather than the intended four.

articles.headline: De Zerbi: Spurs have the quality to stay up
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi says his side have the quality to stay in the Premier League after their 1-1 draw against Leeds.

articles.headline: Leeds' late equaliser keeps relegation pressure on Tottenham
articles.description: Spurs forward Mathys Tel both scores Tottenham's lone goal and concedes a late, reckless penalty to leave his club mired in relegation trouble.

articles.headline: De Zerbi claims referee 'was not calm' as Tottenham held by Leeds
articles.description: Tottenham coach Roberto De Zerbi hit out at the officiating after his team's Monday draw with Leeds, which left Spurs still fighting to secure their Premier League survival.

articles.headline: Tottenham's James Maddison returns from ACL injury after nine months
articles.description: James Maddison made his Tottenham Hotspur return on Monday night, nine months on from rupturing his anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).

articles.headline: Relegation pressure still on Tottenham after draw with Leeds
articles.description: Tottenham forward Mathys Tel went from hero to zero after he gave away a reckless penalty following his opener in a 1-1 draw with Leeds to leave his team mired in relegation trouble.

articles.headline: Fulham eye Filipe Luis as potential Marco Silva replacement - sources
articles.description: Fulham are eyeing Filipe Luis as a potential replacement for manager Marco Silva, should he leave the London club this summer, sources have told ESPN Brasil.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Arsenal eye Juve's Cambiaso
articles.description: Several Premier League clubs are interested in signing Juventus' Andrea Cambiaso. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Rio Ferdinand backs Senne Lammens to be Manchester United No. 1 for next decade
articles.description: Rio Ferdinand has praised "level-headed" Senne Lammens for his impact at Manchester United this season and backed the goalkeeper to be the club's No.1 for the next decade.

articles.headline: Myles Lewis-Skelly: Arsenal's last Premier League games to be treated like 'finals' as title looms
articles.description: Myles Lewis-Skelly insisted Arsenal know "the job is not done" as he promised to treat their last two Premier League matches as finals in a bid to deliver the club's first title since 2004.

articles.headline: West Ham to contact PGMO over controversial disallowed goal against Arsenal - report
articles.description: West Ham are contacting referees' body Professional Game Match Officials (PGMO) to raise their concerns over the controversial disallowed goal at the end of Sunday's match against Arsenal.

articles.headline: Japan waits on star Mitoma's fitness for World Cup after injury in Brighton game
articles.description: Japan coach Hajime Moriyasu has an anxious wait on the fitness of Kaoru Mitoma before naming a World Cup squad on Friday.

articles.headline: Fans, managers can hate on VAR, but Raya incident is why it exists
articles.description: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta is the embodiment of how football wants VAR to work both ways. But Sunday's decision was right, and isn't that what we all want?

articles.headline: Hutchison: Liverpool cannot lose window with so many managers available
articles.description: Don Hutchison says that Liverpool's ownership "need to have a conversation" about changing manager from Arne Slot "to someone better out there like Xabi Alonso."

articles.headline: Hutchison: VAR was right in Arsenal game but there were other fouls
articles.description: Don Hutchison and Julien Laurens discuss the decision to rule out West Ham's equaliser against Arsenal, saying "there were fouls from Rice and Trossard" in the same play.
